note: Re-judged 2026-11-06 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change; no test or record ran for this judgement. RFC 4271 Section 9.1.1: "otherwise, the return value MUST be used as the LOCAL_PREF value in any IBGP readvertisement." The staleness is a doc comment: TestRFC4271LocalPrefIncludedForInternalPeers changed in its comment only, and reactor_wire.go:537-541 is the true citation (lpVal default, stored override, writeLocalPrefAttr). Its claim is wider than its body: it says the value is the stored LOCAL_PREF defaulting to 100, and the route it builds stores none, so it proves the default only; the claim should be narrowed or the tag dropped. The verdict rests on TestRFC4271ImportPolicyLocalPrefIsReadvertisedToInternalPeers, re-read: the source's real import chain computes 200, the internal destination is sent exactly 000000C8 and the external none, and with no policy the internal is sent 00000064, so no constant passes both; both polarities carry observed reach records. Bound: the unit drives the general forward rail. The route-server rail shares applyFactsLocalPref (forward_rs.go:553), and the rib plugin's readvertisement is not driven by it. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
